description: Gets the access control list (ACL) of a Sitecore item — the rules set on the item itself. Narrow it with identity or filter to one account.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

filter.description: Return only the rules for accounts matching this wildcard pattern (e.g. 'sitecore\*').

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

id.description: The ID of the item to get ACL for. Supply this or path.

identity.description: Return only the rules for this exact account (e.g. 'sitecore\Author').

path.description: The path of the item to get ACL for (e.g. /sitecore/content/Home). Supply this or id.

name: security-get-item-acl
